Pet.title: Pet
Pet.description: A companion animal profile owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the pet owner.

weightKg.description: Optional pet weight in kilograms (> 0 and <= 500).

microchipId.description: Optional microchip or clinic registration ID (<= 50 chars).

VaccinationRecord.title: VaccinationRecord
VaccinationRecord.description: An immunization or booster record linked to a user's pet.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the record owner.

petId.description: Document ID of the parent pet under users/{userId}/pets.

vaccineName.description: Name of the vaccine or booster (1-80 chars).

administeredDateEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the vaccine was administered or scheduled.

nextDueDateEpochMs.description: Optional epoch milliseconds for the next booster due date.

clinicOrVet.description: Optional veterinary clinic or doctor name (<= 80 chars).

notes.description: Optional vaccine batch or reaction notes (<= 500 chars).

status.description: Current completion status of the vaccination.

HealthRecord.title: HealthRecord
HealthRecord.description: A veterinary visit, medication, allergy, weight, or wellness note for a pet.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the record owner.

petId.description: Document ID of the parent pet under users/{userId}/pets.

title.description: Short summary title of the health record (1-80 chars).

recordDateEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the health event occurred.

vetName.description: Optional veterinarian or clinic name (<= 80 chars).

details.description: Optional detailed health notes or dosage instructions (<= 1000 chars).

/users/{userId}/vaccinations/{vaccinatio.description: User-owned vaccination records linked to a pet.

/users/{userId}/healthRecords/{recordId}.description: User-owned health and veterinary records linked to a pet.
